summary: OpenAI has introduced an Ultrafast mode for GPT-5.6 Sol, achieving speeds up to 14 times faster and generating 750 output tokens per second, catering to users requiring rapid responses. Google DeepMind's Gemini 3.7 Flash aims to enhance AI capabilities across various applications, though specific features are still pending disclosure. Additionally, OpenAI's builder's guide for GPT-5.6 assists startups in efficiently creating AI agents by optimizing model selection and leveraging new capabilities of the Responses API. Y Combinator's Tokenless product offers a cost-effective solution by automatically switching models without requiring tokens, while Fund Momentum MCP provides real-time venture capital data tailored for AI agents, aiding informed investment decisions.

items.original: MindTopo reveals VLMs’ spatial reasoning abilities. A path, a fence, a knot. MindTopo sets a new benchmark for testing how AI understands topological relationships and highlights new opportunities to strengthen spatial reasoning and planning. The post MindTopo reveals VLMs’ spatial reasoning abilities appeared first on Microsoft Research .
items.rewritten: MindTopo demonstrates the spatial reasoning capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs). It introduces a new standard for evaluating how well AI comprehends topological relationships, such as paths, fences, and knots. This research opens up new possibilities for enhancing spatial reasoning and planning in AI.

items.original: Launch HN: Tokenless (YC S26) – Automatic model switching to save money
items.rewritten: Tokenless is a new product from Y Combinator's Summer 2026 batch that automatically switches models to help users save money. This feature allows for efficient resource management without the need for tokens. It's designed to optimize costs while maintaining performance.

items.original: Previewing Ultrafast mode: GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 14X the speed. Preview Ultrafast, a new OpenAI API service tier that runs GPT-5.6 Sol up to 14× faster. Powered by Cerebras, it delivers up to 750 output tokens per second.

items.original: Show HN: Diffusion PDF – A Diffusion Image Model Embedded Entirely in a PDF File
items.rewritten: Diffusion PDF is a tool that allows users to create images using a diffusion model, all contained within a single PDF file. This means you can generate and view images without needing additional software. It's a convenient way to work with image generation in a portable format.

items.original: Show HN: Alyph, a manual transmission for LLM context
items.rewritten: Alyph is a tool designed to help users manually manage the context of large language models (LLMs). It provides a way to control and adjust the input given to these models, enhancing their output quality. This can be particularly useful for users who want more precision in their interactions with LLMs.

items.rewritten: Strands Agents, LeRobot, and Hugging Face Storage Buckets provide an integrated platform for recording, training, and deploying machine learning models. This all-in-one solution simplifies the workflow for developers and researchers. It allows users to manage their projects efficiently from a single location.
